context.passage:
http://www.talkfirsttechnologies.com
Talk First Technologies
News and Updates
You spoke. We listened.
Effective June 1, Talk First Technologies' customers will have the following options.
• Month-to-month plans-Talk First Technologies will cease offering one- and two-year service
contracts. All services will be billed on a monthly basis.
• New plans-Our newly available options include a low-cost plan that provides unlimited
calling and text messaging for just $45 a month. Purchase data by the gigabyte when you need it.
Or, choose the Techfan plan, which allows you to try our state-of-the-art mobile devices before
they are released for public sale.
• Device upgrades—You will be able to purchase any phone, at any time, at the full retail price.
Our installment plan, which allows you to pay a little each month with no interest charge, is
another option. Get the device you want now.
• Simpler billing statements— Your one-page monthly bill states just the essentials-what
services you used, what you are charged, and when your payment is due. We hope you will try
out the new Talk First app to view your statement and pay your balance using your phone.
context.passage_translation:
http://www.talkfirsttechnologies.com
Talk First Technologies
新闻与更新
您说。我们倾听。
自 6 月 1 日起，Talk First Technologies 的客户将有以下选择。
• 按月计划-Talk First Technologies 将停止提供一到两年期的服务合同。所有服务都将按月计费。
• 新套餐-我们新推出的选项包括一个低成本套餐，每月仅需 45 美元，即可提供无限通话和短信。需要时按 GB 购买数据。
或者，选择 Techfan 套餐，让您在我们的最先进的移动设备公开发售前进行试用。
• 设备升级——您可以随时以全零售价购买任何手机。
我们的分期付款计划允许您每月支付少量款项且无利息费用，是另一个选择。立即获取您想要的设备。
• 更简单的账单明细——您的一页月度账单仅列出必需信息——您使用了哪些服务、您被收取了多少费用以及您的付款到期日。我们希望您尝试使用新的 Talk First 应用程序来查看账单并用手机支付余额。
